comment: The pitch sweep depth is the SWEEP knob times 5, over a knob range of 0 to 1.4, so up to 7 octaves (Kicker.cpp:119). The beater is white noise high-passed at 1750Hz (Kicker.cpp:125) with an envelope that is the pitch envelope to the fourth power (Kicker.cpp:212, :213). The output is a tanh times 5 (Kicker.cpp:218, :220). The channel count follows the trigger input alone, so a polyphonic pitch cable with no polyphonic trigger gives one voice.
